title: 简单英语 · 成年人听说入门教材
source: Newly authored for Easy English; not a recovered original edition.

materials.english: How do you spell your name?
It is good to see you.
The key is on the table.

materials.chinese: 别拘束，就像在自己家一样。

materials.english: What do you do in the morning?
Do you want milk in your coffee?
materials.chinese: 你的咖啡里要加牛奶吗？

materials.english: Do you have any fresh fruit?

materials.chinese: 请给我们安排一张两人桌。

materials.english: Could I have this without onions?
materials.chinese: 这道菜可以不放洋葱吗？

materials.english: Could we have the bill, please?
Could I take this to go?
I am just looking, thank you.
Do you have a smaller size?
Do you have this in blue?
It is too expensive for me.

materials.chinese: 我喜欢这样晴朗的天气。

materials.english: Your jacket is on the chair.
How do I get to the museum?
It is next to the bank.
Could you show me on the map?
materials.chinese: 你能在地图上指给我看吗？

materials.english: The entrance is on your right.
Does this bus go to the station?
Where can I buy a ticket?
Please take me to this address.
How long does the trip take?
materials.chinese: 这段行程需要多长时间？
下一班公交车什么时候来？

materials.english: I would like a return ticket.

materials.chinese: 我在哪里办理登机手续？

materials.english: I have one bag to check.
Can I have a window seat?
materials.chinese: 能给我一个靠窗的座位吗？

materials.english: Where can I collect my luggage?

materials.chinese: 我找不到我的手提箱了。

materials.english: I would like to check in.

materials.chinese: 可以再给我一条毛巾吗？

materials.english: Could I have a quieter room?
materials.chinese: 可以给我换一间安静些的房间吗？

materials.english: Can I leave my luggage here?
materials.chinese: 我可以把行李寄存在这里吗？

materials.english: I would like to stay one more night.

materials.chinese: 我们在这里可以参观什么？

materials.english: How much is the entrance fee?
Could you take a photo of us?
Is there a tour in English?
materials.chinese: 有英语讲解的游览团吗？

materials.english: I would like a map of the city.
We are staying for three days.
Where is the tourist information center?
Let us visit the park first.
I need to see a doctor.
How often should I take this medicine?
materials.chinese: 这种药我应该多久服用一次？

materials.english: The line is not very clear.
Could you send me a message?

materials.chinese: 你的电子邮箱地址是什么？

materials.english: I will send it to you.
Sorry, I have the wrong number.
Can I use the wifi here?
materials.chinese: 我可以使用这里的无线网络吗？

materials.english: Could you show me how to use this?
materials.chinese: 你能教我怎么使用这个吗？

materials.english: I need a copy of this report.
materials.chinese: 我需要这份报告的一份副本。

materials.english: Can you help me with this task?
materials.chinese: 你能帮我处理这项任务吗？

materials.english: I would like to make an appointment.
Could we change the meeting time?
materials.chinese: 我们能更改会议时间吗？

materials.english: How can I help you today?
Would you like to see a sample?
How many would you like to order?
Could you send me a price list?
materials.chinese: 您能发给我一份价目表吗？
你们什么时候可以交货？

materials.english: Could you send me the invoice?
I will check and get back to you.
We look forward to working with you.

turns.chinese: 你好，亚历克斯。我叫萨姆。

turns.english: Excuse me. May I get past?
turns.chinese: 不好意思，我可以过去吗？

turns.english: I am from China. And you?
Yes, I live in this city.
Excuse me. What time is it?
How many tickets do you need?
Is that six in the evening?
Thank you. I would like that.
Hello. I am your new neighbor.
I am Alex. Nice to meet you.
turns.chinese: 我叫亚历克斯。很高兴认识你。
很高兴认识你，亚历克斯。

turns.english: Sorry, I am with my family.
turns.chinese: 抱歉，我正和家人在一起。

turns.english: No problem. Please call me later.
turns.chinese: 没关系，请晚点给我打电话。

turns.english: Of course. Talk to you later.

turns.chinese: 谢谢，我坐这把椅子就好。

turns.english: Would you like me to open the window?
turns.chinese: 你想让我把窗户打开吗？

turns.english: Thank you. That is kind of you.

turns.chinese: 我可以用一下卫生间吗？

turns.english: Of course. It is over there.
What time do you get up?
At six. I walk before breakfast.
Are you going to work now?
Let us rest for ten minutes.
Yes. Do you want to help?
Yes, I have an early start tomorrow.
You too. See you in the morning.
Would you like tea or coffee?
Yes. Do you have an apple?
No, thanks. I do not eat meat.

turns.chinese: 请给我们安排一张两人桌。

turns.english: Could we sit by the window?

turns.chinese: 可以了，请给我一份鸡肉三明治。

turns.english: Thank you for telling me. I will check with the kitchen.
turns.chinese: 谢谢您告诉我。我会向厨房确认。

turns.english: Please make sure there are no peanuts in my food.
turns.chinese: 请务必确保我的食物里没有花生。

turns.english: Of course. I will let you know which dishes are safe.
turns.chinese: 当然，我会告诉您哪些菜可以吃。

turns.english: Can I have the salad without onions?
turns.chinese: 这份沙拉可以不放洋葱吗？

turns.english: Your order will be ready soon.
Could we have the bill, please?
Of course. What size do you need?
Here you are. The fitting room is over there.
Do you have this in blue?
Yes. Here is a blue one.
It looks nice. I will take it.
Thank you. Here is your change and receipt.
I would like to return this shirt.
Thank you. I will check it for you.
What is the weather like today?
Yes, but the evenings are nice.

turns.chinese: 开着，我们可以坐在那里。

turns.english: Excuse me. Where is the station?
No, it is a five-minute walk.
Could you show me the museum on this map?
turns.chinese: 你能在这张地图上指出博物馆吗？

turns.english: Yes. It is here, by the park.
Is this the way to the bank?
Yes. It is across the street.

turns.chinese: 在那栋白色建筑附近吗？

turns.english: It is on the right side of the building.
Where do you want to go?
Follow this street. It is on your left.
turns.chinese: 沿这条街走，就在你的左边。

turns.english: Does this bus go to the museum?
turns.chinese: 这辆公交车到博物馆吗？

turns.english: Yes. Get off at the next stop.
One ticket to the city center, please.
turns.chinese: 请给我一张去市中心的票。

turns.english: Please take me to this hotel.
Of course. Do you have the address?
Yes, it is here on my phone.
Thank you. Please put on your seat belt.
Excuse me. Is this seat taken?
turns.chinese: 打扰一下，这个座位有人坐吗？

turns.english: Thank you. Is this the train to Oxford?
turns.chinese: 谢谢，这是去牛津的火车吗？

turns.english: Do I need to change trains?
Which platform should I go to?

turns.chinese: 我可以看一下您的护照吗？

turns.english: Do you have a bag to check?
Can I have a window seat?
turns.chinese: 能给我一个靠窗的座位吗？

turns.english: Let me check. Yes, seat twelve A.
turns.chinese: 我查一下。可以，十二排 A 座。

turns.english: Thank you. Where is the gate?
Is the flight to London delayed?
turns.chinese: 去伦敦的航班延误了吗？

turns.english: No. Please wait at gate ten.
turns.chinese: 不会，请在十号登机口等候。

turns.english: Where can I collect my luggage?
What is the purpose of your visit?
turns.chinese: 您这次来访的目的是什么？

turns.english: Hello. I have a reservation under Lin.
turns.chinese: 你好，我用林这个名字预订了房间。

turns.english: Welcome. May I see your passport?
turns.chinese: 欢迎，请出示您的护照好吗？

turns.english: Thank you. Your room is ready.
turns.chinese: 谢谢，您的房间准备好了。
包含，供应时间是七点到十点。

turns.english: On the first floor, next to reception.

turns.chinese: 可以再给我一条毛巾吗？

turns.english: Of course. What is your room number?
turns.chinese: 当然，您的房间号是多少？

turns.english: We will bring one to your room.
turns.chinese: 我们会送一条到您的房间。

turns.english: The shower in my room is not working.
turns.chinese: 我房间里的淋浴设备不能用了。

turns.english: I am sorry. We will send someone to check.
turns.chinese: 很抱歉，我们会派人检查。

turns.english: Thank you. I am in room ten.
I would like to check out.
Certainly. May I have your room key?
turns.chinese: 好的，请把房间钥匙给我好吗？

turns.english: Here you are. Can I leave my luggage here until three?
turns.chinese: 给您，我能把行李寄存在这里到三点吗？

turns.english: Yes, we can keep it for you.
turns.chinese: 可以，我们可以为您保管。

turns.english: Yes, but please do not use flash.
turns.chinese: 可以，但请不要使用闪光灯。

turns.english: Could you take a photo of us?
Is there a tour in English?
turns.chinese: 有英语讲解的游览团吗？

turns.english: Please meet the guide at the entrance.
turns.chinese: 请在入口处与导游会合。

turns.english: Yes, please. Can you help me find one?
turns.chinese: 是的，麻烦你帮我找一位好吗？

turns.english: Can I speak to the pharmacist?
turns.chinese: 我可以和药剂师谈一下吗？

turns.english: Thank you. I have a question about my medicine.
turns.chinese: 谢谢，我想问一下我的药。

turns.english: The pharmacist will be with you soon.
turns.chinese: 药剂师马上过来为您解答。

turns.english: How often should I take this medicine?
turns.chinese: 这种药我应该多久服用一次？

turns.english: Please follow the instructions on this label.
turns.chinese: 请按照这个标签上的说明服用。

turns.english: Could you explain the instructions slowly?
turns.chinese: 您能慢慢解释一下这些说明吗？

turns.english: Of course. Let us read them together.
I am at the main entrance of the city station.
turns.chinese: 我在市车站的正门入口。

turns.english: Stay on the line. Help is on the way.
turns.chinese: 请不要挂断电话，救援人员正在赶来。
你好，你能听到我说话吗？

turns.english: Yes, I can hear you clearly.
Good. Is now a good time?
May I speak to Sam, please?
turns.chinese: 请问我能和萨姆通话吗？

turns.english: Sorry, Sam is busy right now.
Could you ask Sam to call me back?
turns.chinese: 能请萨姆给我回个电话吗？

turns.english: Of course. May I have your number?
turns.chinese: 当然，请问您的号码是多少？

turns.english: Thank you. I will check now.
I can send it as a PDF.
turns.chinese: 我可以把它转成 PDF 格式再发给你。

turns.english: No problem. I will send it now.

turns.chinese: 你好，请问这里是酒店吗？

turns.english: No, this is a private number.
Sorry, I have the wrong number.
Hello. This is my first day.
turns.chinese: 你好，这是我上班的第一天。

turns.english: Welcome to the team. I am Mei.
Thank you. Where is my desk?
turns.chinese: 谢谢，我的办公桌在哪里？

turns.english: It is next to mine. I will show you.
Could you show me how to use the printer?
turns.chinese: 你能教我怎么使用打印机吗？

turns.english: Of course. Put the paper here.
Then do I press this button?

turns.chinese: 是的，那样就开始打印了。

turns.english: Can you check this list for me?
turns.chinese: 你能帮我检查这份清单吗？

turns.english: Sure. When do you need it?
All right. I will check it now.
Thank you. Can you email it to me?
turns.chinese: 谢谢，你能发邮件给我吗？

turns.english: Yes, I will send it now.
Great. I will read it this afternoon.
Can you help me with this task?
turns.chinese: 你能帮我处理这项任务吗？

turns.english: I cannot find the right file.
turns.chinese: 我找不到需要的那个文件。

turns.english: Let us look for it together.
Are you free on Monday afternoon?
Could we change our meeting to Friday?
turns.chinese: 我们的会议能改到星期五吗？

turns.english: Friday morning is good for me.
That is fine. I will update the calendar.

dialogues.title_en: Asking a question in a meeting

turns.english: Yes. When do we need to finish?
turns.chinese: 有，我们需要什么时候完成？

turns.english: Could you explain the plan again?
turns.chinese: 你能再解释一下这个计划吗？

turns.english: Of course. We will visit the client first.
turns.chinese: 当然，我们先去拜访客户。

turns.english: And then we will write the report?
I am calling to confirm my appointment.
turns.chinese: 我打电话来确认我的预约。
好的，请问您叫什么名字？

turns.english: Lin. My appointment is at three.
turns.chinese: 我姓林，我预约的是三点。

turns.english: Yes, we have you down for three today.
turns.chinese: 是的，记录的是您今天三点来。

turns.english: Welcome. How can I help you today?
turns.chinese: 欢迎，今天有什么可以帮您？

turns.english: I would like to see your products.
Of course. Please have a seat.
Would you like to see a sample?
Yes, please. Is this the new product?
Yes. You can try it here.
turns.chinese: 是的，您可以在这里试用。

turns.english: Thank you. That would be helpful.
How many would you like to order?
Twenty of the blue ones, correct?
When can you deliver the order?
turns.chinese: 你们什么时候能交付这笔订单？

turns.english: We can deliver it on Tuesday.
turns.chinese: 我们可以在星期二交货。

turns.english: Please send it to our office.
Certainly. Could you confirm the address?
turns.chinese: 好的，您能确认一下地址吗？

turns.english: Could you send me the invoice?
Of course. Is this your email address?
turns.chinese: 当然，这是您的电子邮箱地址吗？
